name: Page
usage: Root component of list, detail and settings pages

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right of the page header.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Toolbar below the page header (filters, search, view switching), usually a Toolbar.

props.name: width
props.description:
Maximum width of the content: `narrow` for forms and settings, `default` for lists and details, `full` for no
limit.

props.name: fill
props.description: The content area fills the remaining height (for pages whose content scrolls by itself, such as a split view).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One sentence of description below the title.

props.name: back
props.description: Back action shown before the title, such as from a detail page to its list.

props.name: titleRef
props.description:
The `<h1>` of the title. It has `tabIndex={-1}`, so it can be focused from code without entering the `Tab`
order: after a client-side navigation, call `titleRef.current?.focus()` so that screen readers announce the new
page and the next `Tab` starts from the top of the content.

types.name: PageBack
types.summary:
The back action of Page and PageHeader: an icon button with an arrow before the title, which goes to the parent
page (from a record to its list). Give `href` for a link, `onClick` for an action, or both for client-side
routing (call `event.preventDefault()` in `onClick`).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Accessible name and tooltip, naming where it goes, such as "Back to projects".

fields.name: href
fields.description: Address of the parent page: the button is rendered as a link (`<a>`).

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Called on click (and on `Enter`, and `Space` for a button).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A list page: title, subtitle and primary action, a search box in the toolbar, and the table wrapped in a
Panel.

examples.name: Narrow
examples.title: Narrow page
examples.description: Forms and settings pages use `narrow` for a more comfortable reading width.

examples.name: BackAndFocus
examples.title: Back action and title focus
examples.description:
A detail page goes back to its list with `back` (a link with `href`). After a client-side navigation, focus the
title through `titleRef`, so that screen readers announce the new page.
